name: Lily Bloom
description: Blooming lily pads in pink, white, yellow and blue, with growth stages (bud, half-open bud, bloom), and giant 4x4 lily pads with a big flower of the same colours. Bone meal grows them, they bloom on their own and generate in swamps. Shear the flower off to get a Water Lily that can be planted on the ground or in a flower pot. Ships 32x and 64x textures that switch on by themselves with packs like Faithful. Required on both server and client.
contributors: Claude (AI by Anthropic): code, textures and models
